NC Farm Bureau | Actuarial Data Scientist | Raleigh, NC (hybrid) | Full-time

We're seeking someone skilled in R and SAS programming, with heavy emphasis on predictive modeling (GLMs and GBMs mostly). SQL and data analysis skills are important, as is being a good problem solver who doesn't shy away from a challenge. Our machine learning/analytics program is still in it's infancy, so if you enjoy building from scratch, architecting workflows, and making a tangible impact - this role is for you. Hybrid work schedule after training period (3 days in office, 2 days remote).
